description: Ooh La La Pet Spaw and Hotel in Jacksonville offers luxury boarding with individual standard and luxury suites, daytime playgroups, and overnight care with monitored facilities available 24/7. The business provides grooming services both in-shop and via mobile units, along with additional amenities including a splash park, Barktique retail shop, and Barkery. Guests sleep on raised beds with fleece blankets, and the facility maintains 24-hour live camera monitoring for security and safety.
